description: This file defines the SettingsEffects class for managing side effects related to application settings in an Angular + NgRx project, including language changes, title updates, and public dashboard ID handling.

classes.name: SettingsEffects
classes.description: Angular service class handling side effects for application settings, such as language change, title update, and dashboard ID management.

methods.name: setTranslateServiceLanguage
methods.description: Effect that updates language settings, local storage, and UI language when the language change action is dispatched.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Effect that updates the page title on language change or route activation events.

methods.name: setPublicId
methods.description: Effect that updates query parameters and dispatches actions related to public dashboard ID when route changes.
